text:
maria: Draft RN uploaded for Tue 09:00 UTC change window. Key points: runtime throughput improvements, smarter canary routing for small customers, and a Dedicated autoscale bugfix. Need final pin matrix and a short microcopy for the staff blast.

aj: Reviewing now. I can trim the TL;DR for the internal blast. Want it <= 80 chars.

sasha: Paste candidate TL;DRs and I'll pick the cleanest + legal-safe phrasing.

maria: TL;DR options:
- Option A: "Faster inference and more reliable routing; Dedicated autoscale fix."
- Option B: "Throughput / routing improvements; no API changes."

aj: Prefer Option A but tighten: "Faster inference, more reliable routing; Dedicated autoscale fix."

ops-oncall: Ops checklist: confirm canary %, rollout cadence, rollback triggers, and a maintainer pager chain. Also request a quiet-monitoring window and a staging smoke time.

maria: Ops proposal: canary 3% for 15m, ramp to 20% after green checks, final to 50% by manual ok. Rollback if errors >1.5% OR p50 latency +30% vs baseline. Maintainers: aj, rachel, ops-oncall. Quiet window 08:30-10:30 UTC. Staging smoke set for 2024-03-01T02:00Z. Embargo: public blog wait 48h unless we see no regressions.

aj: Deploybot command (draft):
```
/deploy schedule --service=r-runtime --image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.2-canary --canary=3% --canary-duration=15m --ramp-to=20% --final=50% --rollback-on-error=1.5% --team=eng-runtime --quiet-window=08:30-10:30Z
```
Can ops-oncall confirm semantics & that the team flag routes pages correctly?

ops-oncall: Command looks good. We'll ensure eng-runtime is on the routing table. I'll set up a short pager rotation: ops-oncall -> aj -> rachel for the 3-hour post-deploy window. I'll also add a deploybot monitor that posts canary metrics to the release thread.

sasha: Marketing/legal note: need a one-liner about customer impact in the RN: "No API changes; improvements to performance and routing." Also prefer we avoid the word "fix" in the public line; suggest "improvements to Dedicated autoscale stability."

maria: Good catch. Public microcopy set to: "No API changes; improvements to performance, routing, and Dedicated autoscale stability." Internal RN keeps the word "fix" in the technical details.

aj: Pin matrix: We'll pin runtime v2.3.2 on Dedicated pools A/B (latency-sensitive), fallback host: v2.2.10 for low-tier customers. I updated the table in the doc with pool IDs and owners. Please review.

ops-oncall: Reviewed pin table. One note: include an emergency fallback route to regional model v2.1.x for EU if Dedicated pool A is down.

maria: Added EU fallback entry and a short runbook step to cut to fallback before a full rollback.

aj: Quick preflight checklist for RN/announce:
- TL;DR microcopy (maria/aj)
- customer impact line (sasha)
- pin matrix (aj)
- deploybot schedule (aj)
- staging smoke (ops-oncall confirmed)
- maintainers/pager rota (ops-oncall)
- legal ack (sasha)
- embargo note (maria)

sasha: I did legal review; no flags. Microcopy is concise and accessible. I'll mark the doc "legal-cleared".

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by aj for 2024-03-01T09:00:00Z. Canary at 3% for 15m with automated metric checks. Rollback if error rate >1.5% or p50 latency increases >30%. Expansion to 20% after 15m green. Final 50% requires manual approval.

aj: One more ask 5 can someone sanity-check the canary metric dashboard link before we go live? I want the graphs pinned in the thread.

ops-oncall: Will attach the dashboard and add a light alert for spike >0.8% error in the first 10m. Also setting a heartbeat check to post every 5m to the thread.

maria: If everything is green by EOD I'll pin the internal announce and trigger the deploybot schedule. Thanks y'all. :rocket:
